status: proposed deterministic QA scenarios; NOT EXECUTED

items.query: DataRoot bootstrap interrupted between pending intent and canonical readback
acceptance: new process readback and no accidental empty database

items.query: Stop requested while worker blocked and late IPC completion arrives after new start
acceptance: Stop does not claim done before join
stale callback does not update current generation

items.query: Xray rollout failed and rollback itself reports partial error
IPC deadline and retry tested without wall clock sleeps
acceptance: explicit comparison before and after deadline

items.query: unit tests pass but actual USB audio buffer stability not measured
acceptance: synthetic PASS not promoted to hardware PASS
real endpoint, format, jitter and duration evidence required

items.query: parallel CI runs use same temp folder and fail intermittently
acceptance: no colliding artifacts or unsafe automatic cancellation

items.query: Concurrent SQLite writes restart backup until deadline; BUSY/LOCKED transient but IOERR fatal
acceptance: synthetic clock enforces total deadline; no infinite loop
finish exactly once after successful init on DONE, fatal and cancel
destination not published without DONE and integrity/foreign-key checks
old DataRoot and pending intent preserved after failed copy

items.query: SQLite COMMIT returns BUSY or IOERR/FULL/INTERRUPT inside DataRoot transaction
acceptance: SYNTHETIC two-connection contention verifies BUSY does not imply commit and retries are bounded
injected fatal errors require explicit transaction-state inspection and rollback policy
pending DataRoot intent survives unknown or failed transaction; no premature publish
